rules.statement: The measure supports group stall housing on bedded lying areas, free-range pig housing and the listed optional supplements.

conditions.description: The profile identifies the Tierwohl – Schweinehaltung measure.

result.description: The o6_22 rule set applies.

rules.statement: The commitment and contract period is one calendar year from 1 January through 31 December.

conditions.description: The rule applies to Tierwohl – Schweinehaltung.

result.description: One calendar year.

rules.statement: The measure and requested supplements renew for another funding year unless deregistered.

conditions.description: No timely deregistration was filed.

result.description: The one-year contract continues for another funding year.

rules.statement: The holding must participate with at least 2.00 GVE across all requested pig categories in the participation year.

conditions.description: The minimum is assessed in total, not separately per category.

result.description: The minimum participation threshold is met.

rules.statement: The 2 GVE minimum is assessed at 1 April or as the annual average when an average-animal list is submitted.

conditions.description: One of the two permitted stock reference methods is used.

result.description: The selected reference stock determines the threshold test.

rules.statement: Participation is available for piglets 8–32 kg, growers and fattening pigs from 32 kg, or breeding sows and mated gilts from 50 kg.

conditions.description: The requested category is one of the measure categories.

result.description: The category may be requested.

rules.statement: Eligible GVE use 0.07 per piglet, 0.30 per grower/fattening pig and 0.50 per breeding sow or gilt.

conditions.description: The animal is mapped through the complete GVE key.

result.description: Multiply eligible heads by the category factor.

rules.statement: Funded pigs must be kept in Austria; only domestic animals count in the premium-relevant livestock stock.

conditions.expression: all funded animals are kept in Austria
conditions.description: The place of keeping is domestic.

result.description: Domestic animals can be counted.

rules.statement: Categories and supplements must be requested in the measures application by 31 December before the contract begins.

conditions.description: The application precedes the contract year.

result.description: A valid contract can begin in the following year.

rules.statement: The last category entry is funding year 2027 and the last entry into optional supplements is funding year 2028.

conditions.description: The requested item is a category or optional supplement.

result.description: The applicable final entry year applies.

rules.statement: A takeover of Tierwohl – Schweinehaltung and its supplements requires the animals and land to come from the same predecessor farm.

conditions.description: The contract is transferred to another farm.

result.description: The common predecessor requirement must be documented.

rules.statement: Violations of access, reporting, substantive, conditionality or contract-period duties may cause premium reduction, withholding or repayment.

conditions.description: The general sanction rules apply to the measure and supplements.

result.description: A measure-specific sanction assessment is triggered.

rules.statement: The annual premium is modulated by total farm area in the general ÖPUL bands of 100%, 90%, 85% and 75%.

conditions.description: The total farm area determines the modulation band.

result.description: Apply the area band to the calculated measure premium.

rules.statement: A stall is a fixed-floor, roofed structure with at least three-sided protection or an accepted open-stall construction; liquid excreta must be collectable where produced.

conditions.description: The animals are claimed under stall housing.

result.description: The structure must meet the measure definition.

rules.statement: Usable total area includes all fixed areas with permanent animal access, including the fixed run; the run may not be closed except for routine work.

conditions.expression: area is fixed AND permanent_access == true
conditions.description: Only permanently accessible fixed areas count.

result.description: The qualifying area is the stall plus qualifying fixed run.

rules.statement: Above 10.00 GVE of eligible pigs, participation in a recognized pig health service is required for the funding year and evidence must be supplied on request.

conditions.description: The threshold is exceeded.

result.description: Recognized health-service participation and proof are required.

rules.statement: Participating piglets, growers/fattening pigs, breeding sows and mated gilts must be housed in groups in stall systems.

conditions.description: Stall housing is used.

result.description: Group housing is required, subject to the documented exceptions.

rules.statement: The stall lying area must be plan-fixed with at most 5% perforation and must provide a dry bedded lying area; absorbent bedding is freely selectable and has no GVE quantity rule.

conditions.description: The lying-area construction and bedding conditions are met.

result.description: The lying area qualifies for stall participation.

rules.statement: Each participating category must have sufficient grass, straw or hay available as enrichment at all times; straw or hay bedding satisfies this, while minimum bedding requires additional constant material.

conditions.expression: enrichment_material in {grass, straw, hay} AND continuously_available == true
conditions.description: The material is available continuously.

result.description: The category meets the enrichment requirement.

rules.statement: A stall sketch and maximum-occupancy plan were required through application year 2024; from application year 2025 they are no longer required.

conditions.description: The historical documentation period applies.

result.description: Keep the plan on the farm for inspection in the historical years; no plan duty from 2025.

rules.statement: Necessary individual housing for a sick or injured animal preserves eligibility for at most 10 days if the animal remains on a bedded system and the reason and duration are documented.

conditions.expression: sick_or_injured == true AND individual_housing_days <= 10 AND bedded_system == true
conditions.description: The health exception is limited and documented.

result.description: The animal remains eligible without a separate AMA report.

rules.statement: Individual housing of a sick or injured animal for more than 10 days requires deregistration from the category and on-farm documentation.

conditions.description: The permitted health exception is exceeded.

result.description: Deregister the affected animal under the AMA reporting rule.

rules.statement: Sows and gilts may be outside group housing only during periods when statutory group housing is not required; all other measure conditions are then also not required.

conditions.description: The statutory exception period applies.

result.description: The statutory exception period is recognized.

rules.statement: Piglets and growers/fattening pigs must meet the measure conditions continuously from reaching eligible weight to the end of rearing or slaughter; only continuously compliant animals may be eligible where existing housing prevents full-category participation.

conditions.description: The animal has continuously met the housing conditions.

result.description: The animal can be included in the category.

rules.statement: Minimum space is assessed per animal, and the average of a homogeneous group determines its weight band.

conditions.description: The group is homogeneous for weight-band calculation.

result.description: Use the homogeneous-group average for selecting the table row.

rules.statement: Piglets and growers/fattening pigs must receive the lying and total area values in the complete weight-band table, with at least 40% of required total area as bedded lying area.

conditions.description: Every animal meets its table row and the 40% bedded-area minimum.

result.description: The table values are satisfied per animal and per stall compartment.

rules.statement: A gilt from 50 kg is in the sow category only after mating; an unmated gilt from 50 kg until mating and culled breeding animals are classified under growers/fattening pigs.

conditions.description: The gilt is not mated.

result.description: Use the growers/fattening pigs category until mating.

rules.statement: Breeding sows require at least 1.30 m² lying and 3.00 m² total area per animal; mated gilts require 0.95 m² lying and 2.00 m² total area.

conditions.description: The applicable sow row is met per animal.

result.description: The sow space table is satisfied.

rules.statement: Free-range density follows the water permit; if no maximum is set, at most 4 GVE per hectare of unfixed free-range area may be held.

conditions.description: The permit or fallback density is respected.

result.description: The applicable density ceiling is met.

rules.statement: Continuous use of an unfixed free-range area as a pig pasture may last no more than one year.

conditions.description: The maximum continuous use period is not exceeded.

result.description: The area may continue to be used under the measure.

rules.statement: The free-range enclosure must prevent wild-boar contact by double fencing or a founded dense enclosure.

conditions.description: One permitted exclusion construction exists.

result.description: The enclosure meets the biosecurity condition.

rules.statement: The feed point and drinker must be spatially separated; they must be on a fixed surface or regularly moved, and the feed point must be roofed.

conditions.description: All three feed-and-water conditions are met.

result.description: The free-range feeding infrastructure qualifies.

rules.statement: Free-range pigs must have a roofed, three-sided and bedded lying area large enough for all animals to lie simultaneously; sows additionally require farrowing huts during farrowing and suckling.

conditions.description: The shelter is sufficient for simultaneous lying.

result.description: The free-range shelter condition is met.

rules.statement: Free-range and stall housing may be combined, but stall requirements apply outside the free-range period.

conditions.description: The holding changes between free range and stall housing.

result.description: Apply the applicable conditions in each period.

rules.statement: Free-range housing must be documented continuously with the start and end of the grazing period per parcel and the number of animals per parcel.

conditions.expression: documentation has parcel, start, end and animal_count
conditions.description: The mandatory log fields are present.

result.description: The ongoing free-range log is complete.

rules.statement: Wild boars in free-range housing are not eligible and must be deregistered.

conditions.description: The animal is a wild boar in free range.

result.description: No premium is paid for the animal and it must be deregistered.

rules.statement: The uncut-animal supplement requires every participating animal in the relevant category to have an uncut tail throughout 1 January–31 December and cannot be applied or removed for individual animals or stalls.

conditions.description: The supplement scope and all-animal condition are satisfied.

result.description: The uncut supplement may be granted for the category.

rules.statement: The GMO-free European protein-feed supplement applies to all animals on the farm for the whole calendar year; non-compliant protein feed may not be stored or fed, including old stocks.

conditions.description: The farm-wide and whole-year conditions are met.

result.description: The protein-feed supplement may be granted.

rules.statement: Protein feed means compound feed above 20% crude protein in dry matter or normally above 20% for single components; roughage is excluded and European origin covers all countries of the continent of Europe.

conditions.description: The product is being classified as protein feed.

result.description: The product falls within the supplement definition.

rules.statement: For purchased protein feed, European origin and GMO-free status must be proven with delivery notes, invoices or feed recipes.

conditions.description: The feed was not produced on the farm.

result.description: Keep documentary proof for inspection.

rules.statement: From application year 2025, the compost supplement requires all solid manure arising on the farm to be piled and turned at least twice at intervals of at least 14 days.

conditions.expression: year >= 2025 AND all_solid_manure_composted AND turn_count >= 2 AND turn_interval_days >= 14
conditions.description: The mandatory compost process is complete.

result.description: The compost supplement may be granted.

rules.statement: A composter must be present on the farm or its inter-farm use must be supported by documents; a front loader alone is not an eligible turning method.

conditions.description: The equipment condition is evidenced.

result.description: The permitted equipment or evidence is present.

rules.statement: A manure pile mixed or layered with crop residues, straw, green cuttings, shrub cuttings or branches may be accepted without turning if an actual composting process is applied; manure-rich straw alone is insufficient.

conditions.description: The turn-free alternative creates a compost pile and applies a composting process.

result.description: Turning is not required for the qualifying mixed/layered process.

rules.statement: The farm must document pile creation, turning, compost spreading or transfer to third parties.

conditions.description: All required compost events are recorded.

result.description: The compost records are complete.

rules.statement: The installation of compost piles must also comply with the Nitrate Action Programme Regulation.

conditions.description: A pile is installed on the farm.

result.description: Apply the referenced nitrate rules in addition to the measure conditions.

rules.statement: The compost supplement cannot be granted for compost stalls because the required composting conditions are not met.

conditions.description: The animals are kept in a compost stall.

result.description: Do not grant the compost supplement.

rules.statement: If stall or free-range requirements cannot be met for one or more animals in a category during the funding year, deregistration must be made immediately; no premium is paid for those animals and the report is annual.

conditions.description: The participating animal cannot meet the measure conditions for the year.

result.description: Report the annual-average number in the Tierwohl attachment.

rules.statement: Pig keepers must report animal entries and exits to VIS and are responsible for the correctness and completeness of AMA and VIS animal information.

conditions.description: The holding keeps pigs.

result.description: Report animal movements to VIS.

rules.statement: The number of pigs kept is reported in the Multiple Application animal list at 1 April or as an annual average; a correction is possible within four weeks after the payment notice with movement evidence.

conditions.description: The annual or reference-date stock is reported.

result.description: Use the permitted stock reporting method and retain movement evidence.

rules.statement: If no premium-eligible animal participates in a category in a funding year, that category contract ends automatically and a new timely application is needed for re-entry.

conditions.description: The category has no eligible animal in the funding year.

result.description: The category is no longer active for that year and re-entry requires a new application.

rules.statement: After completing the one-year contract, the whole measure, individual categories or supplements may be exited.

conditions.description: The one-year obligation has ended.

result.description: The selected scope can be deregistered for the following year.

rules.statement: Deregistration between 1 January and 31 December invalidates the measure for that funding year; if conditions are met through 31 December, deregistration starts on 1 January of the following year.

conditions.description: The deregistration is filed during the current funding year.

result.description: The current year's measure is not valid.

rules.statement: Premium-bearing GVE equal applied heads converted by the GVE key minus heads deregistered from the measure.

conditions.description: Only remaining eligible heads generate GVE.

result.description: Use eligible GVE as the premium base.

rules.statement: From 2024 the base rates are 194.4 €/GVE for piglets, 70.2 €/GVE for growers/fattening pigs and 86.4 €/GVE for breeding sows/mated gilts; supplement rates are represented in the complete data table.

conditions.description: The current 2024+ rate set applies.

result.description: Apply the category base rate and any eligible supplements per GVE.

rules.statement: A tier-holding farm has at least 0.30 RGVE per hectare of feed area; non-cattle stock is taken from the 1 April list or an submitted annual-average list.

conditions.description: The general tier-holding threshold is met.

result.description: The farm qualifies as a tier-holding farm under the general ÖPUL definition.
